package unformatted

// gofmt would rewrite both shapes below, the empty result list to none and the empty statement away, and the guard
// holds every .go file of the tree to gofmt, so this one is kept as text and written out as Go where the test loads it.
// The parser gives `()` a results list of no fields, which is not nil, so the original leaves its
// return alone, and the empty statement before the break is a statement of the clause's body.

func leftAloneEmptyResults() () {
	return
}

var leftAloneEmptyResultsLiteral = func() () {
	return
}

func reportedAfterEmptyStatement(value int) {
	switch value {
	case 1:
		;
		break
	}
}
